scope: Digital skirt demonstrator; sample tests do not certify exact triangle intersections, cloth self-collision, calibrated physics, print hardware, sewability or fit; self-contact is discrete

checks.claim: No fixed cloth vertices; gravity retained
Contact force / gravity / inertia ledger closes
Posterior pelvic coverage: zero exposed samples
Four correctly directed equal-length seam pairs
One sewn shell, Euler 0, two intended boundary loops
Actual FreeSewing Sandy draft and unfolded side lengths
Finite signed fold-angle and curvature fields
Cloth changed from the initial arrangement

coverage.method: Posterior pelvic body vertices, outward -Z visibility rays; cloth must occlude body before skin

support.model: All particles dynamic. Closed reinforced waist edge, mass-weighted shape matching (stiff-belt approximation), body contact and Coulomb friction; no world/body anchors

collision.method: signed nearest body triangle, vertices + edge midpoints + centroids; independent exact triangle intersections also required

bodyProvenance.source: Pattern Agent authored-morph neutral MakeHuman surface

physics.solver: XPBD distance constraints / Verlet, embedded WebAssembly

notRun: Continuous collision detection and universal self-contact robustness
